name: Aquidneck Island Day Camp
description_short: A summer day camp for ages 5-13 at Forrest Ave Elementary School in Middletown, RI, 9am-4pm with extended day 8am-5pm. Campers choose among on-site activities (science, wilderness skills, makers' studio, field games) and go on field trips all summer. Register by the week or for the full summer.
activities: Camp visitors (Mad Science, animal ambassadors, story-telling)

'2026 camp information and registration'; 'Location: Forrest Ave Elementary School'; 'Ages: 5-13'; 'Dates: June 29 – August 21, 2026'; Regular Day 9-4 $300/weekly, Extended Day 8-5 $380/weekly; 'Non-refundable Fee: $25'; call 401-864-3183. Sessions are the 8 Mon-Fri weeks in that range (campers register by the week). Description also uses the Activities page.
Activities page: camp visitors, Wilderness Skills Lab, Makers' Studio, Science, Field Games, field trips.
